title: Capitals
info: A capital is the city where a country's government meets.
The capital is not always the biggest city.

questions.q: What is the capital of France?
What is the capital of Japan?
What is the capital of Italy?
What is the capital of Egypt?
What is the capital of Canada?
questions.explain: Toronto is larger, but Ottawa is the capital.
